# Database Market Data & Indicator API

- Source Swagger: `docs/swagger.json`
- API title: `Toktik Options Platform API`
- API version: `1.0`
- Generated at: `2026-04-15T10:55:09Z`

## Scope

This document exports the database-backed market data and technical indicator query APIs. It intentionally excludes external proxy endpoints such as Polygon, and also excludes backtest, screener, and feature-store analytics endpoints that are not primary market or indicator query surfaces.

## Contents

- [Technical Indicators](#technical-indicators)

- [Crypto Spot Market Data](#crypto-spot-market-data)
- [US Stocks Market Data](#us-stocks-market-data)
- [US Options Market Data](#us-options-market-data)

## Technical Indicators

### DSL indicator series query

- Endpoint: `POST /api/v1/indicators/series`
- Tags: `Indicators`
- Consumes: `application/json`
- Produces: `application/json`
- Summary: Run indicator series query
- Description: Evaluates either a full DSL script or a simplified indicators[] expression list over market bars and returns aligned series arrays.

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| body | body | github_com_Cyvadra_toktik_internal_dto.IndicatorSeriesRequest | yes | Indicator query |

#### Responses

| Status | Schema | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | github_com_Cyvadra_toktik_internal_dto.IndicatorSeriesResponse | OK |
| 400 | github_com_Cyvadra_toktik_internal_dto.ErrorResponse | Bad Request |
| 500 | github_com_Cyvadra_toktik_internal_dto.ErrorResponse | Internal Server Error |

#### curl Example: Simplified indicators[]

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "http://192.168.1.9:9010/api/v1/indicators/series" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
    "market": "us-stocks",
    "symbol": "AAPL",
    "interval": "1h",
    "from": "2024-01-01",
    "to": "2024-02-01",
    "indicators": ["ta.sma(close,5)", "ta.rsi(close,10)"],
    "precision": 2
  }' | jq
```

#### curl Example: Legacy DSL

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "http://192.168.1.9:9010/api/v1/indicators/series" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
    "market": "us-stocks",
    "symbol": "AAPL",
    "interval": "1h",
    "from": "2024-01-01",
    "to": "2024-02-01",
    "dsl": "plot(close, title=\"Close\")\nplot(ta.sma(close,5), title=\"SMA\")",
    "precision": 2
  }' | jq
```

### Factor time series

- Endpoint: `GET /api/v1/factors/bars`
- Tags: `Factors`
- Produces: `application/json`
- Summary: Query factor time-series data
- Description: Returns OHLC bars for a specific factor feed, symbol, and time window.

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | query | string | yes | Factor feed name (e.g. dvol) |
| symbol | query | string | yes | Symbol (e.g. BTC) |
| window | query | string | yes | Time window (e.g. 1h, 1d) |
| from | query | string | yes | Start time (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| to | query | string | yes | End time (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| limit | query | integer | no | Max rows (default 1000, max 10000) |
| cursor | query | string | no | Opaque pagination cursor |

#### Responses

| Status | Schema | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | github_com_Cyvadra_toktik_internal_dto.FactorBarResponse | OK |
| 400 | github_com_Cyvadra_toktik_internal_dto.ErrorResponse | Bad Request |
| 500 | github_com_Cyvadra_toktik_internal_dto.ErrorResponse | Internal Server Error |
